rows.note: Use 垃圾 as the all-purpose noun for discarded rubbish and, figuratively, something worthless or poor-quality.

example.english: Don't keep this trash at home anymore.
example.traditional: 呢啲垃圾唔好再留喺屋企喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 laap6 saap3 m4 hou2 zoi3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 laa3

rows.note: Use 垃圾桶 for a physical trash bin and for the computer location where deleted files are temporarily kept.

example.english: I accidentally deleted the file, but I can still find it in the trash.
example.traditional: 我唔小心刪咗份文件，而家仲可以喺垃圾桶搵返。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 saan1 zo2 fan6 man4 gin6 ji4 gaa1 zung6 ho2 ji5 hai2 laap6 saap3 tung2 wan2 faan1

rows.note: Use 廢物 when stressing that an object or material is useless or has no value, rather than simply calling it rubbish.

example.english: This old phone is complete trash; it won't even turn on.
example.traditional: 呢部舊電話直頭係廢物，連開機都開唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 zik6 tau4 hai6 fai3 mat6 lin4 hoi1 gei1 dou1 hoi1 m4 dou2
